headline: CLE @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.13 at MIL 5.45, with a projected total of 9.58. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +1.38 runs while MIL moved +0.55, changing the projected margin by +0.83 runs. The projected total climbed +1.93, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -18.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Slade Cecconi has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Christian Yelich, William Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags David Fry, David Hamilton because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
